description: Default capability for the main Marktis Optimizer client window. Custom Rust commands (detect_roblox, active_roblox_status, scan_known_executor_processes, open_windows_settings, apply_settings, restore_settings, app_info, get_allowlist, open_external, open_latest_release) are exposed via the invoke handler and are not gated by plugin permissions. No shell or filesystem plugins are enabled.
